title: Input-matched multi-signal colocalization clarifies immune-cell regulatory assignments at primary biliary cholangitis risk loci
description: Preprint and open research compendium for PBC-wide screening followed by source-matched multi-signal reclassification of a prespecified high-information H3/H4 subset. R7C1 adds a bounded IL12RB2-NK validation module using a different FinnGen disease study system, source credible sets and a disease-eQTL/disease-caQTL/peak-gene chromatin triangle. The release distinguishes statistical signal sharing from participant-level independence, direct eQTL-caQTL colocalization and causal mediation.
